Room typeLive Shipment War Room

Primary lensRelease before movement.
Decision nowDecide whether release conditions, funding proof, supplier confirmation, and packet evidence are strong enough for controlled movement or whether the shipment must remain narrow and proof-gated.

Founder ruleDo not treat document completeness, supplier urgency, customer pressure, or packet polish as movement approval unless release, funding, executable-check, document, and containment records carry the same current answer.

Founder Review AgendaLink

SequenceFounder QuestionRequired ReadingDecision Output
First passIs movement actually authorized, or only document-complete?Review pre-shipment release, executable-check board, and document control together.Keep movement narrow unless release proof and executable proof match.
Second passIs outgoing cash synchronized with live gate proof?Review funding release, funding review, and trust posture together.Hold payment acceleration unless funding and release records carry the same answer.
Third passIs supplier confirmation strong enough to avoid compression?Review supplier release packet, response escalation, and supplier resilience together.Keep supplier communication in correction and confirmation posture if timing weakens.
Fourth passIs proof ready for later challenge, audit, or closeout?Review document control, traceability, shipment review, and archive path together.Keep closeout and archive finality blocked until proof is retrievable.
